content.short: Plutus DAO provides cutting-edge infrastructure for defi yield aggregators, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: PlutusDAO is an Arbitrum-native governance aggregator aiming to maximize yield and liquidity for its users by aggregating voting power. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Plutus DAO redefines how users interact with defi yield aggregators. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Arbitrum to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Plutus DAO stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
